title: Service Fabric Application Structure
description: Field-by-field structural documentation for a Service Fabric Application resource

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Application identifier without the fabric:/ URI scheme

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Full application URI using the fabric:/ scheme, e.g. fabric:/MyApp

fields.name: TypeName
fields.description: Application type name as registered in the cluster image store. Must match the ApplicationTypeName in ApplicationManifest.xml.

fields.name: TypeVersion
fields.description: Application type version string. Must match a provisioned version in the cluster.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Current application lifecycle status. Ready means the application is deployed and healthy.

fields.name: Parameters
fields.description: List of application parameter overrides. Parameters defined in ApplicationManifest.xml can be overridden at deploy time.

fields.name: HealthState
fields.description: Aggregated health state rolled up from all services and deployed service packages

fields.name: ApplicationDefinitionKind
fields.description: Whether the application was defined via SF application manifest or Docker Compose file
